instrument: SR 0.741.531.917.2 — Échange de notes du 1er juillet 1971 entre la Suisse et la Belgique sur la reconnaissance réciproque des permis de conduire pour véhicules automobiles
quote_original: reçoit un permis correspondant de l’autre Etat sans avoir à subir un examen
quote_translation: receives a corresponding licence of the other State without having to sit an examination
notes: Reported as recognition-only; that is wrong. The note grants both recognition for temporary driving and exchange without examination. Exchange without exam is limited to light motor cars and motorcycles; an exam may still be required in three listed cases (doubt as to fitness, circumvention of competence rules, professional transport). By special mandate the agreement also applies to Liechtenstein.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.937.2 — Échange de notes des 17 juin/3 juillet 1980 entre la Suisse et la Grèce concernant la reconnaissance réciproque des permis de conduire nationaux
quote_original: obtiendra un permis correspondant de l’autre Etat, sans avoir à subir un examen
quote_translation: shall obtain a corresponding licence of the other State without having to sit an examination
notes: Reported as recognition-only; that is wrong. Recognition runs for one year from entry; exchange without examination arises after one year's stay without a break of three consecutive months. Also applies to Liechtenstein by special mandate.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.941.8 — Échange de notes du 10 septembre 1971 entre la Suisse et la Hongrie sur la reconnaissance réciproque des permis de conduire pour véhicules automobiles
quote_original: reçoivent un permis correspondant de l’autre Etat sans avoir à subir un examen
quote_translation: receive a corresponding licence of the other State without having to sit an examination
notes: Reported as recognition-only; that is wrong. Recognition is for one year; exchange is without examination. Professional drivers may always be required to sit a driving test. Also applies to Liechtenstein by special mandate.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.951.8 — Arrangement du 15 février 1973 entre le Ministère des Transports et de l'Énergie du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg et le Département fédéral suisse de justice et police relatif à la reconnaissance réciproque de permis de conduire nationaux
quote_original: reçoit un permis correspondant de l’autre Etat sans avoir à subir un examen de conduite
quote_translation: receives a corresponding licence of the other State without having to sit a driving test
notes: Reported as recognition-only; that is wrong. Art. 1 is recognition, art. 2 is headed 'Renonciation à l'examen de conduire' and grants exchange. Swiss party is the Federal Department of Justice and Police, not the Confederation.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.951.4 — Accord du 18 juin 2015 sur la circulation routière entre la Confédération suisse et la Principauté de Liechtenstein
quote_original: La nouvelle autorité compétente délivre le permis de conduire sans examen.
quote_translation: The new competent authority issues the driving licence without examination.
notes: Reported as recognition-only; that is wrong. Art. 2 is recognition, art. 4(2) grants issuance without examination on change of domicile. Supersedes the 1978 exchange of notes (in force 1978-03-01 to 2015-08-01) and the 1954 exchange of notes, both of which share SR 0.741.531.951.4. Consolidation date 20220101 is required in the URL; earlier dates return the Fedlex SPA shell with HTTP 200.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.933.2 — Échange de notes des 29 juin/2 juillet 1998 entre la Suisse et l'Espagne relatif à la reconnaissance réciproque et l'échange de permis de conduire nationaux
quote_original: pourra échanger son permis de conduire ou sa licence de conduite contre un permis équivalent de l’Etat de résidence, sans devoir se soumettre à un examen de conduite
quote_translation: may exchange his driving licence or driving permit for an equivalent licence of the State of residence, without having to sit a driving test
notes: Recognition for temporary driving, then exchange for an equivalent licence on establishing normal residence. An exam may exceptionally be required for doubt as to fitness or circumvention of competence rules. The preamble cites the 1968 Vienna Convention as a precondition of comparability, not as the operative exchange instrument.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.945.4 — Accord du 13 mai 2021 entre le Conseil fédéral suisse et le Gouvernement de la République italienne sur la reconnaissance mutuelle en matière d'échange de permis de conduire
quote_original: Chaque Partie reconnaît, aux fins de l’échange, les permis de conduire en cours de validité émis par les autorités compétentes de l’autre Partie
quote_translation: Each Party recognises, for the purposes of exchange, valid driving licences issued by the competent authorities of the other Party
notes: In force 2021-06-12. Supersedes the 2015 Lugano accord (same SR number, eli/cc/2016/356, in force 2016-06-11 to 2021-06-12). Do not confuse with SR 0.741.531.945.41 (Switzerland-Italy, test drives and collective vehicle permits), which is not a driving-licence instrument and is excluded here. Preamble cites EU Directive 2006/126/EC and the 1968 Vienna Convention as preconditions, not as the operative instrument.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.933.61 — Accord du 23 avril 2001 entre la Suisse et l'État fédéral de la Louisiane sur l'échange des droits et privilèges lors de l'utilisation de permis de conduire
quote_original: sans que la personne concernée soit soumise à un examen pratique ou écrit, à échanger son document contre un permis de conduire délivré par son autorité
quote_translation: without the person concerned being subjected to a practical or written examination, to exchange their document for a driving licence issued by its authority
notes: SUB-NATIONAL PARTNER: a single US state, not the United States. The treaty identifies the counterparty as 'l'Etat fédéral de la Louisiane, représenté par l'Officer of Motor Vehicles, Department of Public Safety' and is concluded under the state-law power in La. R.S. 32:404(F); it incorporates LAC 55 Part III Ch. 1 Subch. B ss.171-181 by reference. There is no Swiss-USA federal licence treaty in this series. Scope is limited to private passenger cars ('permis de conduire des voitures automobiles privées'), so class matching is not established: classes_matched null. Renews automatically each year, terminable on 60 days' notice.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.923.27 — Entente de réciprocité du 1er avril 2004 entre le Gouvernement de la Confédération suisse et le Gouvernement du Québec en matière d'échange de permis de conduire
quote_original: assurer la reconnaissance des permis de conduire et en faciliter l’échange
quote_translation: to ensure the recognition of driving licences and to facilitate their exchange
notes: SUB-NATIONAL PARTNER: the Province of Quebec, not Canada. Unlike the other six Canadian instruments this one is government-to-government ('le Gouvernement de la Confédération suisse et le Gouvernement du Québec'); the competent authority is the Société de l'assurance automobile du Québec against the cantonal Services des automobiles. Category correspondence is set out in art. 1.2.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.923.21 — Arrangement du 13 novembre 2000 entre le Département fédéral de l'environnement, des transports, de l'énergie et de la communication et la Province de l'Ontario représentée par le Ministre des transports concernant le permis de conduire
quote_original: sans entraînement à la conduite supplémentaire ni heures de théorie et examen de conduite
quote_translation: without additional driving instruction, theory hours or driving test
notes: SUB-NATIONAL PARTNER: the Province of Ontario, not Canada. Swiss party is DETEC, not the Confederation. Art. 2 is headed 'Echange des permis de conduire délivrés en Suisse'. Swiss B/C1/D2/E maps to Ontario Class G where the holder held the licence at least 24 of the last 36 months, otherwise Class G2; a vision check is required.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.923.22 — Échange de lettres des 19 mars/5 avril 2001 entre le Département fédéral de l'environnement, des transports, de l'énergie et de la communication et la province canadienne de Saskatchewan concernant l'échange de permis de conduire sans examen
quote_original: notre décision d’autoriser l’échange d’un permis de conduire délivré en Suisse contre un permis de conduire de même catégorie
quote_translation: our decision to authorise the exchange of a driving licence issued in Switzerland for a driving licence of the same category
notes: SUB-NATIONAL PARTNER: the Province of Saskatchewan, not Canada. Swiss party is DETEC; counterparty is the Minister responsible for Saskatchewan Government Insurance. Swiss category B or higher maps to Class 5; motorcycle entitlement adds endorsement 'M'. Expressly conditional on Swiss reciprocity.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.923.23 — Échange de lettres du 17 juillet 2001 entre le Département fédéral de l'environnement, des transports, de l'énergie et de la communication et la province canadienne de l'Île du Prince Edouard concernant l'échange de permis de conduire sans examen
quote_original: un permis de conduire délivré en Suisse est reconnu comme pouvant être échangé contre un permis de catégorie équivalente
quote_translation: a driving licence issued in Switzerland is recognised as exchangeable for a licence of equivalent category
notes: SUB-NATIONAL PARTNER: the Province of Prince Edward Island, not Canada. Swiss party is DETEC; counterparty is the provincial Minister of Transportation and Public Works. Swiss B or higher maps to PEI Class 5; motorcycle holders gain Class 6. Theory and practical tests waived. Expressly conditional on Swiss reciprocity.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.923.24 — Échange de lettres des 28/29 août 2001 entre le Département fédéral de l'environnement, des transports, de l'énergie et de la communication et la province canadienne de l'Alberta concernant l'échange de permis de conduire sans examen
quote_original: Alberta Transportation dispense des tests de connaissances et des examens de conduite
quote_translation: Alberta Transportation waives the knowledge tests and driving examinations
notes: SUB-NATIONAL PARTNER: the Province of Alberta, not Canada. Swiss party is DETEC; counterparty is Alberta Transportation. Explicit equivalence table: Swiss B/C/C1/D/D1/D2 to Class 5, Swiss A/A1 to Class 6. Waiver fails if the Swiss licence carries area, speed or hours restrictions, or is suspended or revoked. French text is a translation of the English original.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.923.25 — Échange de lettres des 21 septembre/2 novembre 2004 entre le Département fédéral de l'environnement, des transports, de l'énergie et de la communication et la province canadienne de Terre-Neuve et du Labrador concernant l'échange de permis de conduire sans examen
quote_original: comme pouvant être acceptés pour un échange de permis, dans une classe équivalente
quote_translation: as acceptable for an exchange of licence, into an equivalent class
notes: SUB-NATIONAL PARTNER: the Province of Newfoundland and Labrador, not Canada. Swiss party is DETEC; counterparty is the provincial Director of Motor Registration. Swiss B or higher maps to Class 5; motorcycle holders gain endorsement '06' after a vision test. Oral/written tests and the learner period are waived. Expressly conditional on Swiss reciprocity.

instrument: SR 0.741.531.923.26 — Échange de lettres du 2 mai 2005 entre le Département fédéral de l'environnement, des transports, de l'énergie et de la communication et la province canadienne de Manitoba concernant l'échange de permis de conduire sans examen
quote_original: délivrera un permis du Manitoba de catégorie 5 et de niveau F (intégral)
quote_translation: will issue a Manitoba Class 5 licence at Level F (full)
notes: SUB-NATIONAL PARTNER: the Province of Manitoba, not Canada. Swiss party is the Federal Roads Office (OFROU/ASTRA), counterparty is the Manitoba Department of Driver and Vehicle Licensing. Swiss B maps to Manitoba Class 5 Level F, Swiss A to Class 6 Level F. Requires surrender of the Swiss licence or a Swiss replacement attestation.

instrument: 고시 180 — 대한민국 정부와 벨기에 정부간의 국내운전면허 상호승인협정 체결을 위한 각서교환
quote_original: 대한민국 정부와 벨기에 정부간의 국내운전면허 상호승인협정 체결을 위한 각서교환
quote_translation: Exchange of notes for the conclusion of an agreement between the Government of the Republic of Korea and the Government of Belgium on the mutual recognition of domestic driving licences
notes: Statutory basis is 도로교통법 s.84(2) final proviso, which speaks of an 약정 (arrangement) rather than a 조약 (treaty). That wording is drafting breadth, not a downgrade: this instrument is published in the MOFA treaty register under a 고시 number as a simplified-form international agreement concluded without National Assembly consent, so bilateral_agreement is the correct type. The proviso buys exemption from part of the driving test, not recognition; the exchange itself is issuance of a Korean licence under s.84(1)3 and s.84(3). Separately, this partner is also on the 133-jurisdiction 경찰청 고시 list of 2026-04-06, which alone yields exchange into 2종 보통 only. Signed 1990-01-08/10 at Brussels. The register's 발효일 column gives 1990-01-10 but the document text states entry into force on 1991-01-10; the discrepancy is in the source. Title grants recognition only, yet KoRoad lists Belgium among the five countries obtaining class-matched exchange, so classes_matched is true on the authority's own statement while grants stays at the instrument's wording.

A separate exchange of notes, 고시 630, titled 대한민국 정부와 칠레공화국 정부 간의 운전면허 상호인정에 관한 협정의 일시정지를 위한 교환각서 ('for the temporary suspension of the agreement'), was exchanged 2007-10-30 and 2007-11-07 at Santiago and entered into force 2007-11-07.
